description: WebEOC Traffic Signal Outage is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Main Roads Western Australia. This dataset contains the most recent traffic signal outage information used in the Main Roads Travel Map ( mainroads. wa. gov. au/Home/Map). Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Main Roads Western Australia. Its tags are WebEocTraffic, traffic. It offers 6 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
